caption: The drawing depicts three geometric objects arranged against a plain, light beige background. In the upper left portion, there is a square with pale blue and off-white coloring, with light texture and subtle grayish shading along the bottom edge. Below and to the right of the blue square, there is another square, this one colored green with hints of yellow and blue. This green square has worn, darkened edges and a few small marks or scratches visible on its surface. Placed diagonally between these two squares is a brown triangle, its base aligned with the upper edge of the green square and its tip pointing to the upper right. The triangle overlaps both squares and has a textured, weathered surface. The overall composition is simple, with the three objects centrally located and surrounded by ample empty space.
title: Tiles
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
